title: Verify: Loading message only during in-flight history and 401-retry test still passes
summary: Unit tests for loading visibility with and without a round id
description: Add unit tests for ContributionSheet history loading visibility, with listMine mocked, and re-run the existing 401-retry test.
acceptance_criteria: Test asserts the loading text is absent when roundId is ''
Test asserts loading text and list both present while listMine is pending

in_scope: New test file for loading visibility

technical_constraints: listMine and submitContribution are mocked via vi.mock of ../src/api/client as in tests/contributionHistoryStatus.test.tsx; no network

steps.action: Create the file with the jsdom pragma and the vi.mock of '../src/api/client' (listMine, submitContribution as vi.fn) copied from contributionHistoryStatus.test.tsx lines 1-16. Add test 'hides loading when roundId is empty': render <ContributionSheet open onClose={vi.fn()} roundId="" />, assert screen.queryByText('Loading your suggestions…') is null, assert getByRole('list',{name:'Your suggestions'}) exists, and assert listMine was not called.
steps.expected: Test passes: no loading text, list present, listMine not called

steps.symbol: it('shows loading and the list while listMine is pending')
steps.action: Mock listMine with mockReturnValue(new Promise(() => {})), render with roundId="round-1", assert getByText('Loading your suggestions…') is present and getByRole('list',{name:'Your suggestions'}) is present.
steps.expected: Test passes: both loading text and list visible
